title: useActionState and form validation: Return typed validation feedback from a React form Action without storing duplicated submission flags
description: A practical React 19 lesson for useactionstate and form validation, with an intentionally failing starter, complete TypeScript instructor implementation, local assertions and honest runtime scope.
objectives: Return typed validation feedback from a React form Action without storing duplicated submission flags.
Repair the broken behavior in the react-use-action-state starter.
Demonstrate correct and edge-case outcomes using offline tests.
rubric: I can articulate the React 19 contract for useactionstate and form validation.
I can reproduce, repair and test the 06.04.06 starter case.
I can explain the difference between a local fixture and production persistence or browser behavior.

sources.label: React official: useActionState and form validation
